summary: Recent coverage highlights concerns about federal control over D.C.'s security infrastructure and renewed legislative attention to statehood as a solution to the District's governance challenges. A senator has committed to prioritizing D.C. statehood, while advocates point to ongoing federal oversight as evidence of why local control is needed. Without statehood, D.C. does not control its own National Guard and cannot refuse the deployment of other states' troops within its borders.

articles.title: Why we shouldn’t have National Guard Troops in D.C.
